verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’a·hă·rōn lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses . . . and Aaron . . .
verses.literalPt: FALOU mais o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão dizendo:

verses.original: דַּבְּרוּ֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אִ֣ישׁ אִ֗ישׁ כִּ֤י יִהְיֶה֙ זָ֣ב מִבְּשָׂר֔וֹ זוֹב֖וֹ טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bə·rū ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wa·’ă·mar·tem ’ă·lê·hem ’îš ’îš kî yih·yeh zāḇ mib·bə·śā·rōw zō·w·ḇōw ṭā·mê hū
verses.literal: Say to the Israelites . . . - When any man has a bodily discharge the discharge is unclean
verses.literalPt: Falai aos filhos de Israel, e dizei-lhes: Qualquer homem que tiver fluxo da sua carne, será imundo por causa do seu fluxo.

verses.original: וְזֹ֛את תִּהְיֶ֥ה טֻמְאָת֖וֹ בְּזוֹב֑וֹ רָ֣ר בְּשָׂר֞וֹ אֶת־ זוֹב֗וֹ אֽוֹ־ הֶחְתִּ֤ים בְּשָׂרוֹ֙ מִזּוֹב֔וֹ טֻמְאָת֖וֹ הִֽוא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zōṯ tih·yeh ṭum·’ā·ṯōw bə·zō·w·ḇōw rār bə·śā·rōw ’eṯ- zō·w·ḇōw ’ōw- heḥ·tîm bə·śā·rōw miz·zō·w·ḇōw ṭum·’ā·ṯōw hî
verses.literal: This uncleanness is from his discharge whether his body allows the discharge to flow or blocks it So his discharge will bring about uncleanness
verses.literalPt: Esta, pois, será a sua imundícia, por causa do seu fluxo; se a sua carne vasa o seu fluxo ou se a sua carne estanca o seu fluxo, esta é a sua imundícia.

verses.original: כָּל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛יו הַזָּ֖ב יִטְמָ֑א וְכָֽל־ הַכְּלִ֛י אֲשֶׁר־ יֵשֵׁ֥ב עָלָ֖יו יִטְמָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ham·miš·kāḇ ’ă·šer yiš·kaḇ ‘ā·lāw haz·zāḇ yiṭ·mā wə·ḵāl hak·kə·lî ’ă·šer- yê·šêḇ ‘ā·lāw yiṭ·mā
verses.literal: Any bed on which the man with the discharge lies will be unclean and any furniture on which he sits will be unclean
verses.literalPt: Toda a cama, em que se deitar o que tiver fluxo, será imunda; e toda a coisa, sobre o que se assentar, será imunda.

verses.original: וְאִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִגַּ֖ע בְּמִשְׁכָּב֑וֹ יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš ’ă·šer yig·ga‘ bə·miš·kā·ḇōw yə·ḵab·bês bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ bam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: Anyone who touches his bed must wash his clothes and bathe with water and he will be unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: E qualquer que tocar a sua cama, lavará as suas roupas, e se banhará em água, e será imundo até à tarde.

verses.original: וְהַיֹּשֵׁב֙ עַֽל־ הַכְּלִ֔י אֲשֶׁר־ יֵשֵׁ֥ב עָלָ֖יו הַזָּ֑ב יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hay·yō·šêḇ ‘al- hak·kə·lî ’ă·šer- yê·šêḇ ‘ā·lāw haz·zāḇ yə·ḵab·bês bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ bam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: Whoever sits on furniture on which the man with the discharge was sitting must wash his clothes and bathe with water and he will be unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: E aquele que se assentar sobre aquilo em que se assentou o que tem o fluxo, lavará as suas roupas, e se banhará em água, e será imundo até à tarde.

verses.original: וְהַנֹּגֵ֖עַ בִּבְשַׂ֣ר הַזָּ֑ב יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·nō·ḡê·a‘ biḇ·śar haz·zāḇ yə·ḵab·bês bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ bam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: Whoever touches the body of the man with a discharge must wash his clothes and bathe with water and he will be unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: E aquele que tocar a carne do que tem o fluxo, lavará as suas roupas, e se banhará em água, e será imundo até à tarde.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יָרֹ֛ק הַזָּ֖ב בַּטָּה֑וֹר וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yā·rōq haz·zāḇ baṭ·ṭā·hō·wr wə·ḵib·bes bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ bam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: If the man with the discharge spits on one who is clean that person must wash his clothes and bathe with water and he will be unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: Quando também o que tem o fluxo cuspir sobre um limpo, então lavará este as suas roupas, e se banhará em água, e será imundo até à tarde.

verses.original: וְכָל־ הַמֶּרְכָּ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִרְכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛יו הַזָּ֖ב יִטְמָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl ham·mer·kāḇ ’ă·šer yir·kaḇ ‘ā·lāw haz·zāḇ yiṭ·mā
verses.literal: Any saddle on which the man with the discharge rides will be unclean
verses.literalPt: Também toda a sela, em que cavalgar o que tem o fluxo, será imunda.

verses.original: וְכָל־ הַנֹּגֵ֗עַ בְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִהְיֶ֣ה תַחְתָּ֔יו יִטְמָ֖א עַד־ הָעָ֑רֶב וְהַנּוֹשֵׂ֣א אוֹתָ֔ם יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer yih·yeh ṯaḥ·tāw yiṭ·mā ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ wə·han·nō·w·śê ’ō·w·ṯām yə·ḵab·bês bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ bam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: Whoever touches anything that was under him will be unclean until evening and whoever carries such things must wash his clothes and bathe with water and he will be unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: E qualquer que tocar em alguma coisa que esteve debaixo dele, será imundo até à tarde; e aquele que a levar, lavará as suas roupas, e se banhará em água, e será imundo até à tarde.

verses.original: וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִגַּע־ בּוֹ֙ הַזָּ֔ב וְיָדָ֖יו לֹא־ שָׁטַ֣ף בַּמָּ֑יִם וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer yig·ga‘- bōw haz·zāḇ wə·yā·ḏāw lō- šā·ṭap̄ bam·mā·yim wə·ḵib·bes bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ bam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: If the man with the discharge touches anyone without first rinsing his hands with water the one who was touched must wash his clothes and bathe with water and he will be unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: Também todo aquele em quem tocar o que tem o fluxo, sem haver lavado as suas mãos com água, lavará as suas roupas, e se banhará em água, e será imundo até à tarde.

verses.original: וּכְלִי־ חֶ֛רֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר־ יִגַּע־ בּ֥וֹ הַזָּ֖ב יִשָּׁבֵ֑ר וְכָל־ כְּלִי־ עֵ֔ץ יִשָּׁטֵ֖ף בַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·lî- ḥe·reś ’ă·šer- yig·ga‘- bōw haz·zāḇ yiš·šā·ḇêr wə·ḵāl kə·lî- ‘êṣ yiš·šā·ṭêp̄ bam·mā·yim
verses.literal: Any clay pot that the man with the discharge touches must be broken and any wooden utensil must be rinsed with water
verses.literalPt: E o vaso de barro, que tocar o que tem o fluxo, será quebrado; porém, todo o vaso de madeira será lavado com água.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יִטְהַ֤ר הַזָּב֙ מִזּוֹב֔וֹ וְסָ֨פַר ל֜וֹ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֛ים לְטָהֳרָת֖וֹ וְכִבֶּ֣ס בְּגָדָ֑יו וְרָחַ֧ץ בְּשָׂר֛וֹ בְּמַ֥יִם חַיִּ֖ים וְטָהֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yiṭ·har haz·zāḇ miz·zō·w·ḇōw wə·sā·p̄ar lōw šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm lə·ṭā·ho·rā·ṯōw wə·ḵib·bes bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ bə·śā·rōw bə·ma·yim ḥay·yîm wə·ṭā·hêr
verses.literal: When the man has been cleansed from his discharge he must count off seven days for his cleansing wash his clothes and bathe himself in fresh water and he shall be clean
verses.literalPt: Quando, pois, o que tem o fluxo, estiver limpo do seu fluxo, contar-se-ão sete dias para a sua purificação, e lavará as suas roupas, e banhará a sua carne em águas correntes; e será limpo.

verses.original: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י יִֽקַּֽח־ לוֹ֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֔ים א֥וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֑ה וּבָ֣א׀ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־ פֶּ֙תַח֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וּנְתָנָ֖ם אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇay·yō·wm haš·šə·mî·nî yiq·qaḥ- lōw šə·tê ṯō·rîm ’ōw šə·nê bə·nê yō·w·nāh ū·ḇā lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’el- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ū·nə·ṯā·nām ’el- hak·kō·hên
verses.literal: On the eighth day he is to take two turtledoves or two young pigeons come before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and give them to the priest
verses.literalPt: E ao oitavo dia tomará duas rolas ou dois pombinhos, e virá perante o SENHOR, à porta da tenda da congregação e os dará ao sacerdote;

verses.original: וְעָשָׂ֤ה אֹתָם֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶחָ֣ד חַטָּ֔את וְהָאֶחָ֖ד עֹלָ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧יו הַכֹּהֵ֛ן לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מִזּוֹבֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śāh ’ō·ṯām hak·kō·hên ’e·ḥāḏ ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·hā·’e·ḥāḏ ‘ō·lāh wə·ḵip·per ‘ā·lāw hak·kō·hên lip̄·nê Yah·weh miz·zō·w·ḇōw
verses.literal: The priest is to sacrifice them one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering In this way the priest will make atonement for the man before the LORD because of his discharge
verses.literalPt: E o sacerdote oferecerá um para expiação do pecado, e o outro para holocausto; e assim o sacerdote fará por ele expiação do seu fluxo perante o SENHOR.

verses.original: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּֽי־ תֵצֵ֥א מִמֶּ֖נּוּ שִׁכְבַת־ זָ֑רַע וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֛יִם אֶת־ כָּל־ בְּשָׂר֖וֹ וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš kî- ṯê·ṣê mim·men·nū šiḵ·ḇaṯ- zā·ra‘ wə·rā·ḥaṣ bam·ma·yim ’eṯ- kāl- bə·śā·rōw wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: When . . . . . . a man has an emission of semen he must bathe his whole body with water and he will be unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: Também o homem, quando sair dele o sêmen da cópula, toda a sua carne banhará com água, e será imundo até à tarde.

verses.original: וְכָל־ בֶּ֣גֶד וְכָל־ ע֔וֹר אֲשֶׁר־ יִהְיֶ֥ה עָלָ֖יו שִׁכְבַת־ זָ֑רַע וְכֻבַּ֥ס בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl be·ḡeḏ wə·ḵāl ‘ō·wr ’ă·šer- yih·yeh ‘ā·lāw šiḵ·ḇaṯ- zā·ra‘ wə·ḵub·bas bam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: Any clothing . . . or leather on which there is an emission of semen must be washed with water and it will remain unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: Também toda a roupa, e toda a pele em que houver sêmen da cópula se lavará com água, e será imundo até à tarde.

verses.original: וְאִשָּׁ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכַּ֥ב אִ֛ישׁ אֹתָ֖הּ שִׁכְבַת־ זָ֑רַע וְרָחֲצ֣וּ בַמַּ֔יִם וְטָמְא֖וּ עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’iš·šāh ’ă·šer yiš·kaḇ ’îš ’ō·ṯāh šiḵ·ḇaṯ- zā·ra‘ wə·rā·ḥă·ṣū ḇam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·mə·’ū ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: If a man . . . lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen both must bathe with water and they will remain unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: E também se um homem se deitar com a mulher e tiver emissão de sêmen, ambos se banharão com água, e serão imundos até à tarde.

verses.original: וְאִשָּׁה֙ כִּֽי־ תִהְיֶ֣ה זָבָ֔ה דָּ֛ם יִהְיֶ֥ה זֹבָ֖הּ בִּבְשָׂרָ֑הּ שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה בְנִדָּתָ֔הּ וְכָל־ הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּ֖הּ יִטְמָ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’iš·šāh kî- ṯih·yeh zā·ḇāh dām yih·yeh zō·ḇāh biḇ·śā·rāh šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm tih·yeh ḇə·nid·dā·ṯāh wə·ḵāl han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bāh yiṭ·mā ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: When a woman has a discharge consisting of blood from her body she will be unclean due to her menstruation for seven days and anyone who touches her will be unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: Mas a mulher, quando tiver fluxo, e o seu fluxo de sangue estiver na sua carne, estará sete dias na sua separação, e qualquer que a tocar, será imundo até à tarde.

verses.original: וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛יו בְּנִדָּתָ֖הּ יִטְמָ֑א וְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ תֵּשֵׁ֥ב עָלָ֖יו יִטְמָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer tiš·kaḇ ‘ā·lāw bə·nid·dā·ṯāh yiṭ·mā wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- tê·šêḇ ‘ā·lāw yiṭ·mā
verses.literal: Anything on which she lies - or sits during her menstruation will be unclean
verses.literalPt: E tudo aquilo sobre o que ela se deitar durante a sua separação, será imundo; e tudo sobre o que se assentar, será imundo.

verses.original: וְכָל־ הַנֹּגֵ֖עַ בְּמִשְׁכָּבָ֑הּ יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bə·miš·kā·ḇāh yə·ḵab·bês bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ bam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: and anyone who touches her bed must wash his clothes and bathe with water and he will be unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: E qualquer que tocar na sua cama, lavará as suas vestes, e se banhará com água, e será imundo até à tarde.

verses.original: וְכָל־ הַנֹּגֵ֔עַ בְּכָל־ כְּלִ֖י אֲשֶׁר־ תֵּשֵׁ֣ב עָלָ֑יו יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bə·ḵāl kə·lî ’ă·šer- tê·šêḇ ‘ā·lāw yə·ḵab·bês bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ bam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: Whoever touches any furniture on which she was sitting must wash his clothes and bathe with water and he will be unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: E qualquer que tocar alguma coisa, sobre o que ela se tiver assentado, lavará as suas vestes, e se banhará com água, e será imundo até à tarde.

verses.original: וְאִ֨ם עַֽל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֜ב ה֗וּא א֧וֹ עַֽל־ הַכְּלִ֛י אֲשֶׁר־ הִ֥וא יֹשֶֽׁבֶת־ עָלָ֖יו בְּנָגְעוֹ־ ב֑וֹ יִטְמָ֖א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im ‘al- ham·miš·kāḇ hū ’ōw ‘al- hak·kə·lî ’ă·šer- hî yō·še·ḇeṯ- ‘ā·lāw bə·nā·ḡə·‘ōw- ḇōw yiṭ·mā ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: And whether it is a bed or furniture on which she was sitting . . . whoever touches it will be unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: Se também tocar alguma coisa que estiver sobre a cama ou sobre aquilo em que ela se assentou, será imundo até à tarde.

verses.original: וְאִ֡ם שָׁכֹב֩ יִשְׁכַּ֨ב אִ֜ישׁ אֹתָ֗הּ וּתְהִ֤י נִדָּתָהּ֙ עָלָ֔יו וְטָמֵ֖א שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְכָל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ב אֲשֶׁר־ יִשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֖יו יִטְמָֽא׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’im šā·ḵōḇ yiš·kaḇ ’îš ’ō·ṯāh ū·ṯə·hî nid·dā·ṯāh ‘ā·lāw wə·ṭā·mê šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm wə·ḵāl ham·miš·kāḇ ’ă·šer- yiš·kaḇ ‘ā·lāw yiṭ·mā
verses.literal: If a man . . . lies with her and her menstrual flow touches him he will be unclean for seven days and any bed on which he lies will become unclean
verses.literalPt: E se, com efeito, qualquer homem se deitar com ela, e a sua imundícia estiver sobre ele, imundo será por sete dias; também toda a cama, sobre que se deitar, será imunda.

verses.original: וְאִשָּׁ֡ה כִּֽי־ יָזוּב֩ ז֨וֹב דָּמָ֜הּ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים בְּלֹא֙ עֶת־ נִדָּתָ֔הּ א֥וֹ כִֽי־ תָז֖וּב עַל־ נִדָּתָ֑הּ כָּל־ יְמֵ֞י ז֣וֹב טֻמְאָתָ֗הּ כִּימֵ֧י נִדָּתָ֛הּ תִּהְיֶ֖ה טְמֵאָ֥ה הִֽוא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’iš·šāh kî- yā·zūḇ zō·wḇ dā·māh yā·mîm rab·bîm bə·lō ‘eṯ- nid·dā·ṯāh ’ōw ḵî- ṯā·zūḇ ‘al- nid·dā·ṯāh kāl- yə·mê zō·wḇ ṭum·’ā·ṯāh kî·mê nid·dā·ṯāh tih·yeh ṭə·mê·’āh hî
verses.literal: When a woman has a discharge . . . of her blood for many days at a time other than her menstrual period or if it continues beyond her period she will be unclean all the days of her unclean discharge just as she is during the days of her menstruation
verses.literalPt: Também a mulher, quando tiver o fluxo do seu sangue, por muitos dias fora do tempo da sua separação, ou quando tiver fluxo de sangue por mais tempo do que a sua separação, todos os dias do fluxo da sua imundícia será imunda, como nos dias da sua separação.

verses.original: כָּל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֞ב אֲשֶׁר־ תִּשְׁכַּ֤ב עָלָיו֙ כָּל־ יְמֵ֣י זוֹבָ֔הּ כְּמִשְׁכַּ֥ב נִדָּתָ֖הּ יִֽהְיֶה־ לָּ֑הּ וְכָֽל־ הַכְּלִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּשֵׁ֣ב עָלָ֔יו טָמֵ֣א יִהְיֶ֔ה כְּטֻמְאַ֖ת נִדָּתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ham·miš·kāḇ ’ă·šer- tiš·kaḇ ‘ā·lāw kāl- yə·mê zō·w·ḇāh kə·miš·kaḇ nid·dā·ṯāh yih·yeh- lāh wə·ḵāl hak·kə·lî ’ă·šer tê·šêḇ ‘ā·lāw ṭā·mê yih·yeh kə·ṭum·’aṯ nid·dā·ṯāh
verses.literal: Any bed on which she lies or any furniture on which she sits during the days of her discharge - will be unclean like her bed during her menstrual period . . .
verses.literalPt: Toda a cama, sobre que se deitar todos os dias do seu fluxo, ser-lhe-á como a cama da sua separação; e toda a coisa, sobre que se assentar, será imunda, conforme a imundícia da sua separação.

verses.original: וְכָל־ הַנּוֹגֵ֥עַ בָּ֖ם יִטְמָ֑א וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl han·nō·w·ḡê·a‘ bām yiṭ·mā wə·ḵib·bes bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ bam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: Anyone who touches these things will be unclean he must wash his clothes and bathe with water and he will be unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: E qualquer que a tocar será imundo; portanto lavará as suas vestes, e se banhará com água, e será imundo até à tarde.

verses.original: וְאִֽם־ טָהֲרָ֖ה מִזּוֹבָ֑הּ וְסָ֥פְרָה לָּ֛הּ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים וְאַחַ֥ר תִּטְהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ṭā·hă·rāh miz·zō·w·ḇāh wə·sā·p̄ə·rāh lāh šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm wə·’a·ḥar tiṭ·hār
verses.literal: When a woman is cleansed of her discharge she must count off seven days and after that she will be ceremonially clean
verses.literalPt: Porém quando for limpa do seu fluxo, então se contarão sete dias, e depois será limpa.

verses.original: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י תִּֽקַּֽח־ לָהּ֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֔ים א֥וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֑ה וְהֵבִיאָ֤ה אוֹתָם֙ אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶל־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇay·yō·wm haš·šə·mî·nî tiq·qaḥ- lāh šə·tê ṯō·rîm ’ōw šə·nê bə·nê yō·w·nāh wə·hê·ḇî·’āh ’ō·w·ṯām ’el- hak·kō·hên ’el- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: On the eighth day she is to take two turtledoves or two young pigeons and bring them to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting
verses.literalPt: E ao oitavo dia tomará duas rolas, ou dois pombinhos, e os trará ao sacerdote, à porta da tenda da congregação.

verses.original: וְעָשָׂ֤ה הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת־ הָאֶחָ֣ד חַטָּ֔את וְאֶת־ הָאֶחָ֖ד עֹלָ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלֶ֤יהָ הַכֹּהֵן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה מִזּ֖וֹב טֻמְאָתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śāh hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- hā·’e·ḥāḏ ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·’eṯ- hā·’e·ḥāḏ ‘ō·lāh wə·ḵip·per ‘ā·le·hā hak·kō·hên lip̄·nê Yah·weh miz·zō·wḇ ṭum·’ā·ṯāh
verses.literal: The priest is to sacrifice one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering In this way the priest will make atonement for her before the LORD for her unclean discharge
verses.literalPt: Então o sacerdote oferecerá um para expiação do pecado, e o outro para holocausto; e o sacerdote fará por ela expiação do fluxo da sua imundícia perante o SENHOR.

verses.original: וְהִזַּרְתֶּ֥ם אֶת־ בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִטֻּמְאָתָ֑ם וְלֹ֤א יָמֻ֙תוּ֙ בְּטֻמְאָתָ֔ם בְּטַמְּאָ֥ם אֶת־ מִשְׁכָּנִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiz·zar·tem ’eṯ- bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl miṭ·ṭum·’ā·ṯām wə·lō yā·mu·ṯū bə·ṭum·’ā·ṯām bə·ṭam·mə·’ām ’eṯ- miš·kā·nî ’ă·šer bə·ṯō·w·ḵām
verses.literal: You must keep the children of Israel separate from their uncleanness so that they do not die . . . by defiling My tabernacle which is among them
verses.literalPt: Assim separareis os filhos de Israel das suas imundícias, para que não morram nas suas imundícias, contaminando o meu tabernáculo, que está no meio deles.

verses.original: זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַזָּ֑ב וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר תֵּצֵ֥א מִמֶּ֛נּוּ שִׁכְבַת־ זֶ֖רַע לְטָמְאָה־ בָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ tō·w·raṯ haz·zāḇ wa·’ă·šer tê·ṣê mim·men·nū šiḵ·ḇaṯ- ze·ra‘ lə·ṭā·mə·’āh- ḇāh
verses.literal: This is the law of him who has a discharge of the man who has an emission of semen whereby he is unclean
verses.literalPt: Esta é a lei daquele que tem o fluxo, e daquele de quem sai o sêmen da cópula, e que fica por eles imundo;

verses.original: וְהַדָּוָה֙ בְּנִדָּתָ֔הּ וְהַזָּב֙ אֶת־ זוֹב֔וֹ לַזָּכָ֖ר וְלַנְּקֵבָ֑ה וּלְאִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשְׁכַּ֖ב עִם־ טְמֵאָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·had·dā·wāh bə·nid·dā·ṯāh wə·haz·zāḇ ’eṯ- zō·w·ḇōw laz·zā·ḵār wə·lan·nə·qê·ḇāh ū·lə·’îš ’ă·šer yiš·kaḇ ‘im- ṭə·mê·’āh
verses.literal: of a woman in her menstrual period of any male or female who has a discharge - and of a man who lies with an unclean woman
verses.literalPt: Como também da mulher enferma na sua separação, e daquele que padece do seu fluxo, seja homem ou mulher, e do homem que se deita com mulher imunda.
